name: EPIC 201428034
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 10.9 solar radii and 1.02 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201428034 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.888663 (16th-84th percentiles 10.487802-11.280299), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,585 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.02 solar masses and 10.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,916 K at its surface.
